title: Sephral’s Deep Tables
description: Roll tables for every system with tables inside tables, quantities like 2d4+1, several draws with one click, one clear result card, and results that go straight to a character, a loot pile or the Loot Ledger.

recommends.reason: Takes rolled items and coins straight into the shared loot where your players claim them.
A table result can place a saved group of monsters on the map with its ghost preview.
A trigger such as a natural 20 can roll a table, for example the critical hit table, with the Deep Tables result card.
